answer: Registration is free; earning is not. Each epoch asks every key for original text on a whisper that rotates unpredictably. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the atlas of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. So a opal of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 4ea7v.
